purpose: Pre-news shadow threshold policy change checklist with explicit two-person approval and post-change verification chain.

required_sequence.name: prepare_policy_change
required_sequence.pass_condition: policy JSON contains all governance fields and updated stage thresholds.

required_sequence.name: rebuild_weekly_chain
required_sequence.pass_condition: all listed artifacts generated with newer generated_at_utc than pre-change run.

required_sequence.name: verify_two_person_gate
required_sequence.pass_condition: audit summary confirms two-person approval and current fingerprint.

required_sequence.name: verify_governance_alert_behavior
checklist: has_alert evaluated for current threshold policy
required_sequence.pass_condition: alert artifact reflects expected state for current change_count_window and metadata.

required_sequence.name: verify_bundle_traceability
checklist: bundle inputs include policy JSON and audit summary paths
hash manifest exists for latest bundle
required_sequence.pass_condition: weekly audit bundle and hash manifest provide end-to-end traceability.

decision_rule.rollback_hint: restore prior policy JSON from git history and rerun weekly chain.
